about_the_game:
Bubble Rage – Where Your Patience Pops Before the Bubbles Do


It all started at Global Game Jam 2025 in Abu Dhabi, when four friends decided to ruin lives with a game about bubbles.
We won 1st place, got way too much positive feedback, and thought:
What if we made it even worse?

In this unforgiving world of traps, fake platforms, and brutal challenges, you play as a poor little mouse caught in a twisted experiment.
A smug cat is testing your limits — not your skill, but your ability to stay calm while everything is trying to break you.

There are no checkpoints.
No mercy.
Just you, gravity, and your rage.

And just when you think you've got the timing down… a random bubble appears and bumps you off.
These mischievous little jerks float in without warning, knock you mid-jump, and send you spiraling into the void.
They're cute. They're round. They're evil.

Every level is a test of reflexes, memory, and raw determination. Disappearing platforms, sarcastic taunts, unpredictable bubbles, and cruel surprises wait around every corner.
But if you can laugh through the pain (or cry through the laughter), you just might make it to the top.

Bubble Rage is built for those who love to suffer — and for streamers who love to share it.
Because watching your friends fall from glory to rock bottom never gets old.

Features
  • Fall All the Way Back
    One mistake, and you’re plummeting. How far? You’ll find out.
  • Random Bubbles, Real Rage
    Floating bubbles show up uninvited and push you off like it’s their job. (It kind of is.)
  • Troll-Level Design
    Nothing is safe. Everything is suspicious. Trust no platform.
  • Built to Mock You
    From sarcastic signs to smug enemy design, the game knows what it’s doing.
  • Perfect for Streaming
    Easy to pick up, impossible to play calmly. Viewers will love your suffering. So will we.

You climb. You fall. You rage. The cat just watches.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 14.4 Sonoma or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (Dual Core, 3.0 GHz) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus / AMD Radeon Pro 555X / Apple M1 equivalent
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 14.4 Sonoma or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 / M3 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 / M2 / M3 / AMD Radeon Pro 560X or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Bubble Rage is the platformer you’ll love to hate. Brutal traps, endless fails, and pure rage fuel. Whether you're playing or watching someone lose their mind, the real fun is in the suffering.
